overview.description: The WisdomTree Efficient Rare Earth Plus Strategic Metals Fund (WDIG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund actively manages a blended portfolio of equity and commodities and aims for total return. It invests in companies engaged in strategic metals and rare earth mining activities, and in listed commodity metals futures contracts WDIG was launched on May 7, 2026 and is issued by WisdomTree.
